summary: Astra-health is a student made educational prototype to help monitor astronauts’ health during missions. it includes several physical and mental wellbeing modules. It includes modules for monitoring heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, body temperature and blood sugar, and some additional and important modules for tracking sleep, water intake and exercise. It also comprises two crucial modules bone mass and radiation calculators, which are crucial for astronauts. I also added four outer-space themed games to it that astronauts' can play when bored, there is a satellite tracker and a mission notes taker to keep track of our activities. According to me my project addresses the challenge because it makes complex health monitoring system merged into a simpler one which is easy to use and understand it states all important health related things and highlights some problems caused by long-term spaceflight such as being exposed to radiation and bone mass is affected and especially a disrupt routine of sleep, it also mentions all vital wellbeing modules required. according to me project's broader value lies in its potential as a foundation for future development and would help space agencies to make more accurate models.
details: My project analyses astronauts' health data and tell them what to do accordingly it helps them to understand their condition and what steps can be taken. my projects works simply on a input/output system you will enter the input and it will provide u with appropriate output like everyother project but mine is special because it has many important things like radiation exposure and bone mass calculator. the main benifit of my project is coding of many other accurate health monitoring systems that can be used by astronauts in future because it is really important for a space agency to keep track of health of their astronauts and other benifits consist of things like ; Action-oriented guidance,Astronaut safety awareness,Future potential,Centralized monitoring,Early awareness etc. the modules present in my project are really usefull fore astronauts and my intended impact of this project is devloping of more accurate health monitoring system which can be used by astronauts in future. the coding languages i used were python and HTML it was really fun and i really liked it myself its creative because python is easy to understand and learn u can easily learn something and just make out new fun things.
